Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding hours of availability of special purpose districts for inspection and copying of public records.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to hours of availability for inspection and copyingof public records; and amending RCW 42.56.090.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.56.090 and 2009 c 428 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Public records shall be available for inspection and copying duringthe customary office hours of the agency, the office of the secretaryof the senate, and the office of the chief clerk of the house ofrepresentatives for a minimum of thirty hours per week, except weeksthat include state legal holidays, unless the person making the requestand the agency, the office of the secretary of the senate, or theoffice of the chief clerk of the house of representatives or itsrepresentative agree on a different time. Customary business hoursmust be posted on the agency or office's web site and made known byother means designed to provide the public with notice. Specialpurpose districts that customarily do not maintain office hours for aminimum of thirty hours per week are not required to do so and must p. 1 HB 1389post on the agency headquarters location or web site directions on howto contact agency personnel to inspect or copy public records.
